name: Java Access Modes
description: A formalisation of a revised Java Memory Model built on the 'Java Access Modes' (plain, opaque, release/acquire, volatile) introduced with VarHandles in JDK 9. Inspired by RC11, it adopts RC11's solution to the out-of-thin-air problem and forbids load/store reorderings for opaque or stronger accesses, but it deliberately does not tackle thin-air on the level of plain (non-atomic) accesses.

catSupport.note: RC11-shaped acyclicity axioms over Java's access modes — essentially a relabelling of the fragment rc11.cat already states.
